title: hygiene(changesets): three pending entries still say a `pivot` node's `drillDown` is the shared `DrillDownConfigSchema`; PR #10972 retires it in the same release, so add dated supersession notes
body:
Filing-gate category: ① a defect with named sites, class (b): release text that states something false, **`reach:` exception: text frozen at release**. These bodies publish verbatim into the `@object-ui/types` CHANGELOG at the next Version Packages (npm `@object-ui/core` `latest` is 17.6.0; the entries are pending).

Filed by the `domain:spec @ objectui` seat (session `session_012UwY3ahMixEFkfTUxMVkYm`) from the `out_of_scope_findings` of the dev on objectui#10932 (PR objectui#10972, report on that card). ⛔ Not graded here.

## The sentences, measured on `main` `95a7c8d38`

PR objectui#10972 retires `drillDown` on the bare `pivot` node on both faces: `PivotTableSchema.drillDown?: never`, and a `retirementTombstone` on the zod arm pointing at `object-pivot`. Once it lands, these pending sentences are false for the release:

1. `.changeset/10859-pivot-object-block-zod-arms.md`: 「`drillDown` is the shared `DrillDownConfigSchema`」.
2. `.changeset/7352-drill-down-config-mirror.md`, in its 2026-09-28 dated note: 「its `drillDown` is this entry's `DrillDownConfigSchema`, so the opening paragraph's two referencing declarations are three for the release」.
3. `.changeset/10685-drilldown-per-block.md`, in its dated note: 「a validator does read the members of a `pivot` node's `drillDown`, and accepts `mode` there」.

PR objectui#10972's own changeset states the retirement, but a reader of the CHANGELOG meets the three older sentences first.

## Fix direction (for triage)

- A dated supersession note appended to each entry, in the objectui#10877 / PR objectui#10891 form: frontmatter byte-identical, no existing line edited, the note naming objectui#10932.
- An empty-frontmatter or no-new changeset, per `check-changeset-presence`.
- `Clause-②: no`.
- **Serial:** after PR objectui#10972 lands; before release PR #5400 is merged.
- **Possible second member:** objectui#4356's W4, a dated note on `.changeset/7759-dashboard-header-global-filters-spec.md` (dev record `5866443287`), if the maintainer routes it here rather than into PR #10930. That choice is held for the maintainer.

## Who acts, and the one constraint

The `domain:spec @ objectui` seat dispatches it once graded. ⚠️ In this seat's session the auto-mode classifier refused a dev's append to a pending changeset (「Modify Shared Resources」, objectui#4356 `5866443287`), and the maintainer is deciding how that write lands. This card is dispatchable by whoever holds that write, or once the maintainer settles it.

## Dedupe

Semantic issue search on objectui (open and closed) for 「date-note pending changeset entries that a later PR in the same release made false」 gives 24 hits. The first 10 were read:
- the closed precedents objectui#10877, #9042, #9065, #8617, #10030, #10074, #9003 and #10010;
- the open objectui#9649 and #9528, which are `domain:devx` cards on other entries or gate design.

None carries these three sentences. Dedupe words: `pivot` `drillDown` `DrillDownConfigSchema` pending changeset · dated supersession note · 10859 / 7352 / 10685 changeset
